package assignments;


public class SecondLargeNoArray {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

		
		/*
		 *  Q1. Find the Second Largest Element
			Write a Java program to find the **second largest distinct element** in an integer array.
			
			**Input:**
			`{12, 45, 7, 89, 34, 89, 56}`
			
			**Expected Output:**
			`Second largest element: 56`
		 */
		
		int [] arr = {12, 45, 7, 89, 34, 89, 56};
		int largest=arr[0];
		int secondLargest=arr[0];
		for(int i=0;i<arr.length;i++)
		{
			if(arr[i]>largest)
			{
				largest = arr[i];
			}		
		}
		for(int i=0;i<arr.length;i++)
		{
			if(arr[i]<largest)
			{
				if(arr[i]>secondLargest||secondLargest==largest)
				{
					secondLargest=arr[i];
				}
			}
		}
		System.out.println("Secondlargest = "+secondLargest);
	}

}
